method: Repository scripts/architecture_import_map.py loaded with runpy as a source-only analyzer; ast.parse scans selected source trees. No application imports or live reads.
limitations: Static import inventory, not runtime reachability or removable-code measurement.
Includes conditional, function-local and TYPE_CHECKING imports; plugin enablement and dynamic imports are not resolved.
Existing analyzer domain labels are legacy heuristics, not target-product ownership.
The analyzer records from-import module bases, not every imported symbol; relative package imports require manual review.
Historical upstream authorship and percent remaining were not measured.
Runtime data, deployment revision, credential state and production activity were not read.
